cmd.description: 📚 Your FFXIV collections from FFXIV Collect: check an item, see what's missing, server leaderboard

title: 📚 {name} — {world}

state.notfound: ⚠️ **{name}** isn't on FFXIV Collect yet. Search for your character once on [ffxivcollect.com](https://ffxivcollect.com), then press 🔄 Refresh.
state.private: 🔒 This character is set to private on FFXIV Collect. Make it public there, then press 🔄 Refresh.
state.down: ⚠️ FFXIV Collect can't be reached right now. Please try again later.
state.stale: ⚠️ FFXIV Collect can't be reached right now — showing the last saved data.
state.achHidden: ℹ️ Your achievements are hidden on the Lodestone, so they count as 0. Make them public in your Lodestone settings to see them here.

onlyOwner: ⚠️ This panel belongs to someone else. Use `/collect` to open your own.
refreshWait: ⏳ You can refresh again in {min} min.
noResult: No mount, minion, achievement, card… found for **{query}**.
didYouMean: No exact match for **{query}**. Do you mean:
unknown: ❔ Pingway can't tell if you have it (this collection is private or not synced yet).
rarityValue: {pct}% of FFXIV Collect players have it
missingPick: 📋 Pick a category to see what you're still missing (easiest first).
missingHidden: 🔒 This collection is private on FFXIV Collect (or not synced yet).
lbEmpty: No verified Main characters with FFXIV Collect data in this server yet.
lbSyncing: ⏳ {n} more members are syncing — check again in a few minutes.
lbFooter: Verified Main characters in this server
lbGuildOnly: 🏆 The leaderboard only works in a server.
showWait: ⏳ The leaderboard was just posted here. Try again in {sec} s.
showNoPerm: ❌ Pingway can't post in this channel (it needs View Channel, Send Messages and Embed Links).
listsMissing: 📚 The item list isn't loaded yet, so this can't be checked right now. Please try again later.
error: ❌ Something went wrong with FFXIV Collect. Please try again.
